# claude-poetry-skill

> A Claude Code skill that turns git commits into haiku, senryū, tanka, or renga — either grounded in the actual diff or freely imagined.

This repository hosts the source-of-truth files for the `poet-commit` skill. Activate it by copying `poet-commit/` into `~/.claude/skills/poet-commit/`. The skill picks a poetic form automatically based on the size of the staged diff, generates a poem with strict syllable counts, and previews the commit message before letting `git commit` run.

## Skills
- [poet-commit](poet-commit/SKILL.md): turn git commits into haiku, senryū, tanka, or renga, grounded in the diff or freely imagined

## Reference
- [poet-commit forms](poet-commit/forms.md): syllable rules and structural notes for haiku, senryū, tanka, and renga
- [poet-commit examples](poet-commit/examples.md): curated good and bad poetic commits

## Optional
- [README](README.md): top-level project overview, installation, and modality examples
